en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet returns to Tai Kwun swan show this weekend
en.dek: Tai Kwun lists adapted House of Swans performances on Saturday and Sunday afternoon, with exhibition tickets at HK$50 and entry limited by gallery capacity.
body: Tai Kwun Contemporary has scheduled further adapted performances of Anne Imhof's House of Swans this weekend, performed by Hong Kong Ballet. The venue lists sessions on 10 and 11 October from 2:30pm to 3:15pm, part of a run of adapted performances that also includes later dates in October and November.

The exhibition's performance partner is Hong Kong Ballet. Opening-week performances with the company and an international cast were held on 25 and 26 September. Tai Kwun says gallery capacity is limited and admission is first come, first served; a reservation does not guarantee immediate entry, and visitors may have to queue at busy times.

Tickets are on sale through Art-mate and in limited numbers at the JC Contemporary reception. The listed price is HK$50, or HK$40 for full-time students with valid identification, people with disabilities, and seniors aged 60 or above. Children aged four and under enter free.

Weekend guided tours titled Who's Next? run on Saturdays and Sundays through 3 January, free with an exhibition ticket bought that day. Cantonese or Putonghua sessions are listed at 1:30pm and English sessions at 3pm.

zh.headline: 大館《House of Swans》周末再有香港芭蕾舞團演出
zh.dek: 大館公布10月10及11日下午2時半至3時15分有改編演出，展覽門票50元，場內人數有限，先到先得。
body: 大館當代美術館本周末再安排Anne Imhof展覽《House of Swans》的改編演出，由香港芭蕾舞團演出。場地列出10月10日及11日下午2時30分至3時15分的場次，同系列其後在10月及11月另有日期。
展覽的演出夥伴是香港芭蕾舞團。開幕周與香港芭蕾舞團及國際演員的演出已於9月25及26日舉行。大館表示為保障參觀體驗，展廳人數有限，入場先到先得；成功預約不保證可即時進場，繁忙時段或需輪候。
門票經Art-mate發售，JC Contemporary接待處亦有少量即場票。正價50元，全日制學生憑有效證明、殘疾人士及60歲或以上長者優惠價40元，4歲或以下小童免費。
名為「Who's Next?」的導賞團逢周六日舉行，直至1月3日，當日持展覽門票可免費參加。粵語或普通話場為下午1時30分，英語場為下午3時。
